message:
test(safety): the injection gate's standard is --input-injection-mode none, its whole line from this launch (Codex: mode=none adopted)

Codex codex_test_injection_finding.md "OFF 표현 상충 판단 -- mode=none 채택": the parser's supported none (Disabled)
is the common default; a --config profile clears every runtime override it can carry, not only the injection, so
d9a3a91's config (with only the overrides it mirrored) is not the default.

- e2e_injection_off_arg() = " --input-injection-mode none" (nothing written).
- the gate passes only THIS launch's whole line "input injection disabled (unsupported mode) mode=none" ending its
  line: mode=none2 / an unknown mode's fallback / the config line / a prefix / a line still being written are not it;
  enabled, a config not loaded, silence -> RESULT: INVALID before any client (as before).
- header: this turns off INPUT injection only -- SAS, credential typing, clipboard, restart and the display wake at
  a stream start are other OS effects (os_input_effects.hpp record-only build).
- e2e_injection_guard_test 16/16 (5 new: CRLF, the exact argument, mode=none2, mode=bogus, a partial line).
  All 15 affected targets build. Not yet run (slot; the display-wake decision).
